name: agent-qa
description: Tests web, Android, and iOS apps from plain-language steps for software teams and coding agents, with persistent memory and validated self-improvement.

skills.name: Plain Language Testing
skills.description: Run user journeys against web, Android, and iOS interfaces from plain-language test steps, retaining evidence for each step.

skills.name: Persistent Test Memory
skills.description: Store learned product facts and working procedures as reviewable files, then retrieve relevant knowledge for future test runs.

skills.name: Validated Self Improvement
skills.description: Check lessons from completed runs before applying them, retire outdated knowledge, and incorporate feedback on test verdicts.

skills.name: Coding Agent Integration
skills.description: Let MCP clients author and execute tests, inspect run evidence, correct verdicts, and manage knowledge in the local project.

authInstructions: The local MCP server uses no tokens. Test execution requires a configured model provider or supported subscription authentication; provider charges may apply.
